name: React & Next.js
metaTitle: React and Next.js Development for SaaS and AI Products
description: Techlio builds fast, server-rendered SaaS applications, complex analytics dashboards, and interactive AI interfaces in React and Next.js.
h1: React and Next.js front ends *for products people use every day.*
answer: React is the most widely used library for building web interfaces, and Next.js adds server rendering and routing for fast, search-friendly applications. Techlio uses them to build SaaS products, dashboards and AI interfaces, with design, accessibility and performance handled by the same team.

builds.title: SaaS web applications
builds.text: Multi-tenant products with complex forms, real-time updates and role-based views.

builds.title: Dashboards and data views
builds.text: Clear, fast interfaces over operational and AI data.

builds.title: AI interfaces
builds.text: Chat, review and approval screens with streaming responses and source citations.

fits: You need a responsive web product with rich interaction
You want web and mobile to share code and skills
You are adding AI features that need streaming responses and review screens

faqs.question: Do you design as well as build?
faqs.answer: Yes. UI and UX design are part of the same team and process.

faqs.question: Can you modernise an older front end?
faqs.answer: Yes. We have moved large products off outdated frameworks in stages, with regression testing.

faqs.question: Do you use TypeScript?
faqs.answer: By default, for safer changes and easier hand-over.
